title: CJK text odt 002
notes: real CJK fixture: Bashō haiku 古池や 蛙飛びこむ 水の音 (Japanese kana+kanji) and an 애국가 line 동해물과 백두산이 마르고 닳도록 (Korean Hangul), every CJK paragraph styled with the named paragraph style "GP CJK" whose text-properties set style:font-name-asian="Noto Serif CJK SC" plus fo:language="zh" fo:country="CN" (the asian font-name slot, not the latin fo:font-name). Honest caveat: one shared style tags zh/CN even in 002, so Japanese and Korean text are zh-tagged — font substitution for kana/Hangul is renderer-font dependent (Noto CJK covers all three scripts when installed). Reference text is the exact character strings; no normative ODF counter matches, feature counts stay 0.
